children: Indian shares dipped on Monday after posting four consecutive weekly declines, with IT stocks leading a broad-based selloff as escalating tensions in the Middle East and rising odds of a U.S. rate hike in September weighed on risk sentiment.
Changes to pre-open session rules aimed at aligning the mechanism more closely with the newly launched closing auction session (CAS) came into effect at the start of trading.
